title: OpenAl4S: Code as Action, Science as Sessions
abstract: arXiv:2609.15096v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI co-scientists could accelerate computational research, but over a long-running study the workflow also has to stay inspectable, resumable and reproducible, which requires persistent computational state and provenance. Here we present OpenAI4S, an open-source scientific research agent built around the principle of \emph{Code as Action, Science as Sessions}. OpenAI4S combines a persistent computing runtime with research-session management: orchestration is handled through structured tool calls, while scientific actions are represented as complete code cells executed in persistent Python and R kernels. An append-only Action Ledger, per-cell execution records, versioned artifacts, environment records, and workspace checkpoints preserve how results were produced and support session recovery, branching, and extension. translated_title: OpenAI4S：代码即行动，科学即会话
translated_abstract: AI协同科学家能够加速计算研究，但在长期运行的研究过程中，工作流程还必须保持可检查、可恢复和可复现，这需要持久的计算状态和来源追踪。在此，我们提出OpenAI4S——一个围绕“代码即行动，科学即会话”原则构建的开源科学研究智能体。OpenAI4S将持久计算运行时与研究会话管理相结合：编排通过结构化工具调用实现，而科学行动则表示为在持久化Python和R内核中执行的完整代码单元。仅追加的行动账本、逐单元执行记录、版本化工件、环境记录和工作区检查点保存了结果的产生过程，并支持会话的恢复、分支和扩展。可配置的沙箱、权限控制以及代码与轨迹筛查提供了互补的安全保障。我们评估……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: OpenAI4S是一个以“代码即行动，科学即会话”为核心原则的开源科学研究智能体，通过持久化Python/R计算内核、行动账本、执行记录与工作区检查点等机制，保障长期科研工作流的可检查性、可恢复性与可复现性。
en_tdlr: OpenAI4S is an open-source scientific research agent built on the principle of "Code as Action, Science as Sessions," which combines persistent Python/R computing runtimes with session management features (append-only action ledger, per-cell execution records, and workspace checkpoints) to keep long-running computational research inspectable, resumable, and reproducible.
